text:
Sam (Sales): Heads-up handoff for Orchid Therapeutics trial -> moving to CS + infra ops. Theyre on Dedicated VPC with SSO. Main pain: peering pending, SCIM half-configured, embeddings ingestion failing intermittently. Renewal ~10mo, flagging as medium risk if we cant stabilize perf.
Priya (CS): Thanks Sam. Can you paste the current infra summary and their tech contact? Also any existing support tickets?
Sam (Sales): Tech contact: lena@orchid.io (CTO). Infra snapshot: ```
account: orchid-thera-prod
deploy: dedicated-2xA100
region: us-east-1
vpc_cidr: 10.200.0.0/16
ssoconfig: okta (SCIM partially enabled)
embeddings: nightly-batch failing ~20%
expected_traffic: 3k req/day, peak ~80rps
```
Sam (Sales): Opened support ticket SUP-4622 for ingestion errors and peering request. Link: https://redwood.internal/sup/SUP-4622 (internal).
Diego (Support): Thanks. I'll own SUP-4622 and drive the peering work. First ask: who on Orchid can approve route tables? Sam pls add their infra owner to the ticket.
Sam (Sales): Added mark_infra@orchid.io to SUP-4622.
Anika (Solutions Eng): For latency: propose canary with tuned kernels + KV cache warm-up. Suggest: fp16 quant + continuous batching window 25ms. If we can get p50 <150ms under 50rps thats promising. Need sample payloads and service account key.
Priya (CS): Owners: Priya = CS lead / kickoff owner; Diego = SUP-4622 peering + ingestion; Anika = canary perf + SSO integration; Sam = sales liaison/commercial.
Priya (CS): Short-term next steps: 1) Diego confirm peering ETA and triage ingestion errors. 2) Anika run canary and post perf. 3) Priya schedule kickoff + collect pre-call checklist from customer. 4) Sam follow-up on approvers.
Diego (Support): Starting peering preflight. ETA 24-48h if no route issues. Will post checklist to SUP-4622.
Sam (Sales): Customer prefers Tue morning for kickoff. Priya can you do Tue 9am ET?
Priya (CS): Tue 9am ET works. I'll send invite with agenda: peering status, SCIM timeline, canary results, ingestion backlog plan.
Anika (Solutions Eng): Canary config I'll deploy: dedicated-canary-a100-quant, seq_limit=1024, cache_warmup_count=50. Command Ill use for synthetic: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $CANARY_KEY" -d '{"input":"short prompt for chat"}' https://canary-us-east-1.redwood/api/v1/generate
```
ticket-bot: SUP-4622 created and assigned to Diego (Support).
deploy-bot: Deployment started: dedicated-canary-a100-quant at 1775559960 by anika.
Anika (Solutions Eng): Canary run initial results under light sim (20rps): p50=140ms p95=310ms. Embedding pipeline unaffected in this sim. Need peak sim (80rps) to validate.
Diego (Support): Pulled ingestion logs: failing jobs show intermittent 503 from their S3 provider during nightly window. Will require retry/backoff and alerting; adding remediation steps to SUP-4622.
Priya (CS): Renewal risk notes: competitor pitch around faster embeddings and SLA offers. If we can't reduce p95 under heavy load, mark medium-high renewal concern. Priya -> will add to account health dashboard and schedule weekly checkpoints until stable.
Sam (Sales): I'll prepare commercial options (commit tiers / burst credits) to present if perf needs ramping.
Priya (CS): Action summary (for thread): - Priya: kickoff invite Tue 9am ET, account health entry, customer comms - Diego: SUP-4622 updates, VPC peering ETA, ingestion remediation - Anika: run peak canary, post perf + config diff, SSO test run - Sam: confirm approver contact, commercial fallback options
Anika (Solutions Eng): Will paste full canary log to SUP-4622 and update here when peak sim completes.
deploy-bot: Canary completed at 1775560038 by anika, logs uploaded to SUP-4622.
Diego (Support): Peak sim (80rps) now ran. Initial observation: p50=155ms p95=420ms, memory/local cache thrash at sustained 80rps. Will need further tuning or a small scale-up to meet target p95<350ms.
Priya (CS): Ok. Diego/Anika, please capture a short remediation plan and timeline in SUP-4622. I'll send pre-kickoff email to Lena with ask: confirm peering approver, SCIM admin, and provide sample embedding job config.
Sam (Sales): Thx team. I'll join kickoff and monitor renewal flagging. :thumbsup:
